title: Consensus Algorithms
text: Blockchain technology has become a popular means of distributed ledger systems that allow for secure and transparent transaction recording. To ensure the integrity of these transactions, blockchain networks rely on something that is called as consensus algorithm, whose job is to ensure that transaction added to the blockchain are legitimate and that the network remains secure
